newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products stable, gas oil premiums slide.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products stable, gas oil premiums slide.

text.p: NWE oil products were stable on Thursday in quiet trade after an industry function in London.
Gasoline recovered their early losses to end unchanged, after NYMEX futures staged a rally in the afternoon.
Naphtha was steady, supported by a jump in crude futures and balanced fundamentals in Europe.
Gas oil was boosted by firmer futures but premiums for Russian cargoes and barges were under pressure from U.S. heating oil arrivals.
Fuel oil cargoes were steady to narrowly weaker, but barges dropped up to $4 a tonne, trading as low as $121.50 fob ARA.
